findings.evidence: Line 92 uses `testFunctionLp_injective`, whose signature requires only `IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ`; line 117 applies `MemLp.locallyIntegrable` to `μ.restrict Ω`, which requires only `IsLocallyFiniteMeasure (μ.restrict Ω)`. Mathlib provides the restriction instance from ambient local finiteness, but the proof never otherwise uses the stronger ambient assumption.
findings.fix: Replace it with `[IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure (μ.restrict Ω)]`; the former supplies `testFunctionLp`, while the latter supplies local integrability of the L² representative.
findings.issue: `exists_norm_le_hasWeakLineDerivOn_of_abs_integral_lineDeriv_mul_le` unnecessarily requires `[IsLocallyFiniteMeasure μ]`, including local finiteness outside `Ω`.

summary: The representation theorem still assumes ambient local finiteness although its two uses require different, strictly weaker measure properties.
